skill.name: best-work-email
skill.description: Find the best available work email for one person with Leadsets. Check addresses you already have and see their verification status before using them.
skill.summary: Find or check one work email and see its verification status.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The command, environment access, and reconnaissance alerts come from Markdown, service documentation, or output labels. The Leadsets connection sends contact data off-platform, and a verified candidate can be saved to a CRM contact without proof that it belongs to that person. No evidence found of prompt injection or covert data transfer.

remediation.issue: A verified candidate may be assigned to the wrong CRM contact.
remediation.suggestion: Check that the address belongs to the intended contact before updating the CRM. Keep unconfirmed matches in chat and preview the target record and proposed change for approval.

remediation.issue: The workflow sends identifiers and candidate addresses to Leadsets.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose which fields go to Leadsets before the first lookup. Use an approved connection, send only necessary work contact data, and keep API keys out of prompts and output.

content.user_title: Find and Check a Work Email
content.value_statement: An old address may be invalid or belong to a previous employer. Find the best available work email with Leadsets and see its verification status before using it.
actual_capabilities: Look up one person from a LinkedIn profile URL or a full name and employer.
Check the remaining Leadsets record allowance before enrichment.
Retrieve a current role, company, and work email when Leadsets has a matching record.
Check distinct email candidates you supply without rechecking the address returned by enrichment.
Rank results by verification status and report confidence, check date, and lower-ranked addresses when available.
Write one result to a CSV, Google Sheet, or CRM when requested and a suitable connection is available.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets account and a configured MCP connection or REST API key.
Handles one person per run and does not guess missing email addresses.
Catch-all and unknown results are not verified. A verified mailbox does not prove who owns it.
Quota limits can stop a lookup. This skill does not send email or guarantee delivery.

use_cases.title: Find an address before an introduction
use_cases.description: Look up one contact by profile URL and check the verification status before writing.

use_cases.title: Check an address from an old conversation
use_cases.description: Compare a prior work address with the current employer and the best result from Leadsets.

use_cases.title: Review a contact record before updating it
use_cases.description: Compare the existing CRM address with a new result in chat before deciding whether to change the record.

prompt_templates.title: Find one work email
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the best available work email for [LinkedIn profile URL]. Show the verification status in chat.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a profile URL and no candidate address.

prompt_templates.title: Check an address you already have
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the best work email for [full name] at [company domain]. Check [candidate email] and explain why it ranked higher or lower.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have an older address and know the employer domain.

prompt_templates.title: Check for an employer change
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up [profile URL] and compare the current employer with [previous employer]. Check [candidate email], but do not recommend an address at the previous employer.
prompt_templates.scenario: The contact may have changed jobs.

prompt_templates.title: Review a proposed CRM update
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [profile URL] and [current CRM email]. Show the suggested address, status, confidence, and check date. Do not update the CRM.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to review one proposed change before authorizing a write.

best_practices: Provide a profile URL or a full name and employer domain to reduce mismatches.
Use an approved Leadsets connection and provide only contact data you are authorized to share.
Confirm the address belongs to the intended person and review the target record before requesting a CRM update.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to guess email patterns or verify made-up addresses.
Treating a catch-all or unknown result as verified.
Replacing a CRM address based only on mailbox status without checking the contact match.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: You need a Leadsets account and either the Leadsets MCP connection or a Leadsets REST API key.

faq.question: What data is sent to Leadsets?
faq.answer: A lookup sends the profile URL or the person's name and employer domain. Verification sends the candidate addresses you provide for checking.

faq.question: What does catch-all mean?
faq.answer: The domain may accept mail for many addresses. The specific mailbox is not confirmed.

faq.question: What happens if there is no usable address?
faq.answer: The result explains why no address was selected. The skill does not guess an address or recommend an invalid one.

faq.question: How many records does a run use?
faq.answer: The quota check is free. A successful person enrichment uses one record, and each separate email verification uses one record.

faq.question: Does the skill update the CRM by default?
faq.answer: No. It replies in chat by default. An update requires a request and an available CRM connection.
